Tooltip_MinidoracatTesla_NoCarInReach: No Tesla within reach of the cable
Tooltip_MinidoracatTesla_TakeDriveUnitPa: This will set drive unit condition to 0.
Tooltip_MinidoracatTesla_KeyCard:
Tap it on the reader on the driver's door pillar to lock or unlock.
To drive, carry it loose or on a keyring (it does not start the car from a wallet).
Tooltip_MinidoracatTesla_Phone:
Sit in a Tesla with its key card and right-click this phone to set it up as a phone key.
With Vehicle Manager, the car's owner needs no key card.
Tooltip_MinidoracatTesla_PhoneKey:
Unlocks when you pull a door handle.
Doors lock by themselves when you get out and walk away with it.
Tooltip_MinidoracatTesla_TapCard: Walk to the driver's door and tap the key card on the reader
Tooltip_MinidoracatTesla_PairPhone: Authorize this phone with this car's key card
Tooltip_MinidoracatTesla_PairPhoneOwner: Authorize this phone without the key card: you manage this car in Vehicle Manager
Tooltip_MinidoracatTesla_AppNotPaired: Pair this phone first: sit in the Tesla with its key card, right-click the phone and choose Set Up as Phone Key. With Vehicle Manager, the car's owner needs no key card.
